requests.editorial: Build home, collection and PDP for Aurum Nordic. Warm ivory and deep green, restrained serif headlines, a split editorial lead, three proportional product cards and a compact supporting story. Mobile stacks the lead and uses two compact collection columns. Use only supplied fictional facts and approved imagery. Keep price, availability and options readable.
requests.direct: Use the same Aurum facts, catalogue and asset pool. Make the direction product-first: sans-serif headings, pale surfaces, tighter spacing, product rail before editorial story and smaller lead. Keep the same home/collection/PDP functions. Do not alter commerce or add claims.
requests.transfer: Use the same capabilities for Arki Objects with the supplied two-product fixture; sparse product-first collection and generic Size choices on Reuna mug. No new commerce claims.

selectedSectionRevision.instruction: Change only story-home to foreground the Kehä pendant: use necklace-34372548; heading "A little light, close to you" / "Ripaus valoa lähelläsi"; retain the supplied pendant description as body. Preserve all other sections, pages and theme.
